request.subject: UNIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change three things only. Erase the glowing yellow ball at the bottom left completely, leaving that area transparent. His sword becomes a huge two-handed greatsword: the blade twice as broad and taller than his plume, with a big gold crossguard. Add a short crimson tabard with a bold gold cross over his breastplate. Do not redraw anything else: keep the plumed helmet, face, plate armour, pose, proportions, feet, black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
